# TypeSwitch

> TypeSwitch is a multilingual keyboard that eliminates language-switching errors for bilingual and multilingual professionals.

## What is TypeSwitch?
TypeSwitch is a smart, illuminated keyboard that displays only the relevant letters and shortcuts based on the active language. Language switching is done with a physical selector — no keyboard shortcuts, no interruptions, no loss of focus.

## The Problem We Solve
Multilingual typists constantly face: typing in the wrong language, accidental Alt+Shift triggers, symbol confusion across languages, and broken concentration. These problems affect millions of people daily with no simple solution.

## Key Features
- Per-key RGB LED indicators showing only the active language in real time
- Physical language selector lever (supports 2-4 languages)
- Modular magnetic keys — removable and swappable
- Smart NumLock shortcut pad (Writing, Design, Dev modes)
- Plug & Play — works immediately on Windows and Mac
- No complex drivers or settings required

## Target Audience
- Multilingual professionals and remote workers in global teams
- Translators, content creators, students
- People with ADHD or learning disabilities who benefit from visual clarity
- International business professionals (sales, support, finance)

## Pricing
- Basic keyboard: $100–$120
- Extensions and accessories: $10–$30

## Languages Supported
Initial focus: Hebrew and English. Expandable to up to 4 languages per key (Arabic, Russian, French, and more planned).

## FAQ
Q: Does it work on Mac and Windows?
A: Yes, Plug & Play on both platforms.

Q: Can I switch between more than 2 languages?
A: Yes, the physical selector supports up to 4 language positions.

Q: Is it available now?
A: Currently in pre-order phase. Join the founding users list at typeswitch.io.

Q: What makes it different from gaming keyboards?
A: TypeSwitch is built for multilingual workflow efficiency, not gaming. It focuses on language clarity, not RGB aesthetics.
